policy: Reviewed, hand-authored independent cores. Pipes separate a source ID suffix from its approved replacement, never a runtime word-stripping rule. Exact duplicates share one canonical value; additional semantic consolidations below are explicit. A split preserves its full original only in the historical archive. It never automatically inserts extracted categories.
